reviewMethod: Actually opened the regenerated 16:9 and 3:4 originals, their 320px and 160px derivatives, and the regenerated 320/160 contact sheets.
findings: The relocated 16:9 血管调血压 label is now centered in the gap above the vessel and below the islet; it no longer touches or overlaps the islet cells. It is visually associated with the vessel.

The relocated 3:4 血管调血压 label is now in open space to the right of the islet and above the vessel. It no longer overlays the islet; the vessel shifted upward and its principal lumen/branches remain visible within the canvas.
4:3 and 9:16 versions remain the cleanest label placements from the previous review; no label-to-object obstruction was seen in the regenerated contact sheets.
The title 如何科学减肥？ remains the dominant message, and the teal color strip 5分钟科普 · 血压血糖血脂 remains intact. The left-top rainbow鱼 logo/wordmark is complete with no obvious white rectangular background.

At 320px, title, logo and the three colored mechanism labels are still distinguishable. At 160px, the main title remains recognizable; small black-strip and mechanism-label text is too small for reliable word-by-word reading, which is acceptable for a thumbnail-scale hierarchy.
No newly introduced clipping or edge collision is evident in the 3:4 vessel after its upward move. Review is visual and does not certify pixel-perfect safe-area margins on every publishing platform.
limitations: Only these regenerated cover files and contact sheets were opened; this is not a platform upload preview or device-specific safe-area test.
No source-code, typography-font rasterization, or scientific geometry audit was performed in this cover-only review.
The review does not predict click-through rate or certify aesthetic perfection.
A 160px thumbnail cannot support reading every secondary label; the main title is the intended primary message.
